https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/nineteen_e.text: [Simulated page] Nineteen Eighty-Four (1984) is a 1949 dystopian novel by George Orwell. Set in Oceania, it follows Winston Smith, a low-ranking Party member who rebels against the totalitarian regime of Big Brother. Themes include mass surveillance, propaganda, and the manipulation of language through Newspeak.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/harry_pott.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone — Wikipedia
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/harry_pott.text: [Simulated page] Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone is a 1997 fantasy novel by J.K. Rowling. It follows Harry Potter, an orphan who discovers he is a wizard and enrolls at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. The novel introduces Voldemort as the primary antagonist.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/the_kite_r.title: The Kite Runner — Wikipedia
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/the_kite_r.text: [Simulated page] The Kite Runner is a 2003 novel by Khaled Hosseini. Set in Afghanistan, it follows Amir, a wealthy boy from Kabul, and his servant Hassan. The story spans decades of Afghan history from the fall of the monarchy through the Soviet invasion and Taliban rule.
